confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are triangulated from aggregated Düsseldorf sources (mostly user-reported, dated 2023 to 2026), using a July 2026 cappuccino benchmark and a 2025 beer-garden draft price. Beer assumes a 0.5 l restaurant draft; local Altbier is often served in smaller glasses, so a smaller serving would cost less. No Düsseldorf wine-glass or cocktail price was found, so wine is set at about 1.1 times the beer anchor (Berlin house-wine proxy as a check) and cocktail at about 2.2 times beer (a Düsseldorf club price as a check). The midrange two-person meal is the least certain food anchor because sources vary widely. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates; no accommodation search or live listing was checked. EUR prices were converted at an assumed 1.15 USD per EUR, which is not a sourced rate. The FX value comes from a search summary citing the RBA exchange-rates page for 18 Nov 2026; I did not open that page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Düsseldorf-specific food sources where available; Berlin served as a proxy for the wine-glass and cocktail checks. Accommodation is a holistic estimate informed by Düsseldorf's trade-fair-driven hotel demand and general knowledge of large German cities, not a searched comparable.
